items.source: Sets the classpath that the task will examine when resolving the main class name.
items.translation: 设置任务在解析主类名时要检查的类路径。

items.source: Sets the classpath that the task will examine when resolving the main class name. The given classpath is evaluated as per Project.files(Object...).
items.translation: 设置任务在解析主类名时要检查的类路径。 给定的 classpath 按照 Project.files(Object...) 进行评估。

items.source: Creates a new instance of the ResolveMainClassName task.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 ResolveMainClassName 任务实例。

items.source:
Returns the classpath that the task will examine when resolving the main class
name.
items.translation: 返回任务在解析主类名称时将检查的类路径。

items.source:
Returns the property for the explicitly configured main class name that should be
used in favor of resolving the main class name from the classpath.
items.translation: 返回显式配置的主类名称属性，该属性应优先于从类路径解析主类名称。

items.source:
Returns the property for the task's output file that will contain the name of the
main class.
items.translation: 返回包含主类名称的任务输出文件的属性。

items.source: the configured main class name property
items.translation: 已配置的主类名称属性

items.source: Task for resolving the name of the application's main class.
items.translation: Task 用于解析应用程序主类的名称。
